# Reviewed TruffleHog findings in history that cannot be fixed by editing a
# line (secret-scan.yml's Report findings step reads this file).
#
# One finding per line: <full commit sha> <path> <line> <DetectorName>, then
# `# ` and why it is safe. A finding matches only when all four agree, so a
# new commit, file, line or detector is never covered. A verified finding
# still fails the scan even if it is listed here: verified means live.
#
# Use this only for a finding in a commit already on a pushed branch, and only
# after reading the line and confirming the value is synthetic. A finding in
# the change you are making gets a `trufflehog:ignore` comment on its line (or
# a value no detector matches) instead. Never list a real credential: rotate it.
#
# Issue #818: Postgres URIs in test fixtures. TruffleHog tried to connect to
# their hosts, the DNS lookup failed, and an errored verification counts as
# `unknown`, which fails the scan.
